notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
Small update with small little fixes.

- Price no longer increases by a HUGE amount.
- Amount owned text now resets when you rebirth.
- Removed developer reset input to avoid accidentally resetting your progress. 

NOTE: you might still see previously owned items if you rebirthed before this update.

notes.title: Minor release day bug fixes
notes.content:
Turns out i overlooked some bugs before releasing the game.

So i did some fixing.

Bug fixes:
- Rebirth screen now actually works.
- no longer start in profile screen.
- profile picture isn't dark anymore.

Features:
- You now start in windowed mode with a re-sizable window.

Bugs found:
- Resizing the window causes the themes page to glitch out due to it maintaining it's size. Will be fixed soon.

notes.title: Cheese is released early!
notes.content:
I have decided to release cheese a week early to give you all a taste of what is to come in our future full version!

We hope you all enjoy the game so far. 

Report bugs to us if you find any, suggest features to be added and share your scores! 

- Shadowclaw Games

notes.title: An important little update.
notes.content:
We at ShadowClaw really like to listen to the community. Hereby we've decided to remove all steam inventory item ideas from this video game to make it more enjoyable.

[h2] What will happen now? [/h2]

We've chosen to make the game paid instead of free to play so that we could still make money off of this project. 

With this change though, we're going to make the game worth your money. We're going all out to make sure you have the best experience, all for only $3.99.
And we will still implement your cheese icons into our game for no additional cost! Just send them to us on our Discord server once it goes public and we will most likely add it to the game!

We do apologize for thinking steam items was a good idea. I hope this announcement clears everything up for all of you, and we hope to see you clicking soon!

notes.title: Cheese will be releasing in November!
notes.content:
It has been over a month since i started developing Cheese | The Cheese Collector. And i am happy to announce that the game will be releasing November 1st.

We plan on releasing the game with a bunch of features. That includes.
- Trading cards
- Many more Achievements
- A steam item store where you can sell/trade items you gain by playing the game
- A rich and unique Discord Rich Presence that will display your live stats for everyone to see
- Leader boards
- A bunch of community made cheese icons for you to click on!

We will open up our Discord server where you can share your custom cheese to be in the game or the item shop!

Hope to see you all clicking soon!

P.S. I just want to make it clear now so people don't get the wrong idea;
We offer steam store items in a way that is different to other such games, I.E: Banana, CATS
In our games, you can buy these steam items using your in-game earned currency or random drops that appear every 3 hours, we don't just hand them out to everyone like that. 
So you NEED to actually play the game to unlock them. We aren't a cash grab Corporation.

If you don't like that, then simply don't play our game.
